_comment: Tier C 0114. ONE table of cases for the staff arithmetic (apps/web/lib/scheduling/closed-days-core.ts closedDayOverlap, run by closed-days-core.test.ts) and the portal SQL (closedDayOverlapExists in store.ts, run against Postgres by closed-days-portal.db.test.ts). Both must give `closed` for every case. Instants are UTC; the Lisbon wall clock is in each name. Lisbon is UTC+0 in winter and UTC+1 in summer; 2027-03-28 and 2027-10-31 are the clock-change Sundays.
